description: This file contains the CreditAllocationsValidator class, which provides validation logic for credit allocation rules in loan products, including strategy validation and order checks.

classes.name: CreditAllocationsValidator
classes.description: Service class responsible for validating credit allocation rules and strategies in loan products.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a list of credit allocation rules against a given strategy code, checking for duplicates and correctness.

methods.name: validatePairOfOrderAndCreditAllocationType
methods.description: Validates the ordering and uniqueness of credit allocation rules ensuring correct configuration.

methods.name: hasDuplicateTransactionTypes
methods.description: Checks whether there are duplicate transaction types in the provided rules.

methods.name: validateAllocationRule
methods.description: Validates individual credit allocation rule, specifically the presence of a valid transaction type.

methods.name: isAdvancedPaymentStrategy
methods.description: Determines whether the given strategy code is 'advanced-payment-allocation-strategy'.

methods.name: hasLoanProductCreditAllocationRule
methods.description: Checks if any credit allocation rules are present.

methods.name: raiseValidationError
methods.description: Throws a validation exception with specified error message and code.
